review_scope: Final numerical admission for the existing 18-stock Gin Vetiver Cypress Air EDP search; not a universal rejection of research datasets.
review_authority: Parent Codex evidence adjudication; manifest is an audit record, not learned validation.

proposals.reason: Sources describe material functions and intended design roles. Admit for proposal explanation only, not dose-response, numerical richness, layering or liking.
Within-group transfers preserve the scored sum algebraically. Identical scores do not discriminate the proposed ratios.
Mass-weighted individual-material valence priors are not a held-out validated predictor of this mixture's liking or target fit.

Graph input omits amounts and training drops intensity/pleasantness. It cannot distinguish same-palette dose transfers or validate body/richness/layering. Notebook split/head bugs are consequently not prerequisites for this final run.
Frozen grouped holdout RMSE 0.289364 is worse than unchanged-profile 0.263070; additionally requires measured source profiles and has single-molecule descriptor endpoints, not full-perfume liking.

Input prerequisite is a measured odor profile at another concentration. Exact natural-stock mixture profiles are unavailable here. The supplied single-molecule task does not cover this 18-stock perfume; further tuning cannot resolve that input/domain mismatch.

Equal-volume combination of prepared component solutions is confirmed by the official discussion. Exact active mass fractions and delivery conditions remain unresolved. Eight solvent-matched identity groups do not establish a validated formula-only model for these natural mixtures in an ethanol EDP or for richness/layering. Excluded from numerical selection in this version, not discarded.
Binary-mixture baselines require human component intensity/pleasantness inputs. They do not provide a concentration-to-perception bridge or validated transport to this 18-stock EDP.
OAV is a threshold/physics screen, not liking, richness, layering or perceived contribution. Physics remains separately available; no OAV or safety gate is weakened to obtain an aesthetic pass.
